# AVNIGOLD SEEDS PRIVATE LIMITED

> Premium quality seed supplier based in Mandsaur, Madhya Pradesh, India. We offer vegetable seeds, field crops, and hybrid varieties trusted by farmers across India.

## Company Overview

AVNIGOLD SEEDS PRIVATE LIMITED is a premier seed company dedicated to providing superior quality seeds to farmers. We combine innovation with agricultural expertise to deliver exceptional crop solutions. Our seeds undergo rigorous quality testing with 98% germination rates and are trusted by over 50,000 farmers.

- Founded in Mandsaur, Madhya Pradesh, India
- 500+ seed varieties available
- 98% germination rate guaranteed
- Quality certified and tested seeds
- Serving farmers across India

## Products

We offer a wide range of premium seeds:

- **Vegetable Seeds**: Tomato, Chilli, Onion, Brinjal, Okra, Cucumber, Bottle Gourd, Bitter Gourd, Watermelon, Muskmelon, Coriander, Fenugreek, Cabbage, Cauliflower, Carrot, Radish, Spinach, Peas
- **Field Crops**: Soybean, Wheat, Maize, Cotton, Mustard, Chickpea (Gram)
- **Hybrid Varieties**: High-yield hybrid seeds developed through advanced research

## Quality & Research

- State-of-the-art R&D laboratory
- Rigorous multi-stage quality testing
- International certification standards
- Continuous seed improvement programs
- Field trial validation across multiple agro-climatic zones
